S7 Classes for the Information Matrix

Source: R/information.R
Information.Rd

Information is the abstract parent of the objects that select which matrix is taken as the information of a likelihood: the observed information, which is the negative Hessian of the log-likelihood at the data, or the expected (Fisher) information. Its two subclasses are ObservedInfo and ExpectedInfo. They are built by observed_info() and expected_info(), which are the functions to call; the classes are exported so that S7::S7_inherits() can test an object, and so that a package can define a subclass of Information for a further choice of matrix. information_objects compares the two.

ObservedInfo has no properties. ExpectedInfo has one, method, which is NULL or an object that inherits from ExpectMethod and selects how the expected information is obtained. The raw constructors do not validate their properties; the functions observed_info() and expected_info() do.

Usage

Information()

ObservedInfo()

ExpectedInfo(method = NULL)

Arguments

method

NULL or an object inheriting from ExpectMethod, for ExpectedInfo.

Value

An S7 object of the class named, which inherits from Information.

See also

information_objects for the comparison of the two constructors; observed_info() and expected_info() for the constructors; vcov.distrib_fit() for a function that takes the object.

Examples

a <- expected_info(method = expect_mc(nsim = 500))
S7::S7_inherits(a, Information)
#> [1] TRUE
S7::S7_inherits(a, ExpectedInfo)
#> [1] TRUE
a@method
#> Expectation by Monte Carlo (nsim = 500)
